fullContentHtml:
RBI Office Attendant Score Card & Cutoff 2026 – Full Details

Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has release the Score Card & Cutoff for the post of Office Attendant. This recruitment was released for 572 posts. Applications for the RBI Office Attendant Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 15 January 2026, to 04 February 2026. The online examination was conducted on 28 February 2026 to 01 March 2026. Candidates who had appeared in this exam can download their RBI Office Attendant Score Card & Cutoff 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 15 January 2026
  • Last Date : 04 February 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 04 February 2026
  • Correction / Edit Form : 10-11 February 2026
  • Exam Date : 28 February & 01 March 2026
  • Admit Card : 23 February 2026
  • Result : 22 June 2026
  • Score Card & Cutoff : 04 November 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 450/- (+GST Extra 18%)
  • SC, ST, PwBD, EXS : Rs. 50/- (+GST Extra 18%)

How to Check Result

  1. Click on the direct official result link provided below.
  2. Enter your Roll Number / Registration Number and Date of Birth.
  3. Submit the form to view your scorecard on screen.
  4. Download and print a copy of the result for future reference.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is RBI Office Attendant Score Card & Cutoff 2026?

RBI Office Attendant Score Card & Cutoff 2026 is the official result announcement. Candidates can check their scorecard and merit status via the direct link above.

All verified official links are available in the Important Links table above on this page.
